notes.title: Demo Bug Fix!
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to fix some bugs within the game

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where player was returning from drop off, got stuck on ship
[*] Fixed bug where after fueling, player warp gets broken
[*] Fixed mouse cursor disappearing during a minigame when switching between devices fast enough
[*] Fixed glitch were minigame wont appear if player interacts with device too fast
[*] Fixed a bug where a game over screen hard locks the game 
[*] Disabled pausing during station landing in tutorial
[*] Fixed audio pop when leaving start ship and entering play area

[/list]
